summary: Import routes issues through the shared issueCreate mutation path and returns an actionable typed-command error for resources without a GraphQL import adapter.
reason: Linear is GraphQL-only with no REST create endpoint, so the generated POST /<resource> loop rejects every record with a missing-query error. A regeneration must preserve issue import through issueCreate, including team resolution, pp_created tracking, and local-store write-back.
validated_outcome: Automated tests verify per-record issueCreate mutations, continued processing after malformed and rejected records, pp_created and local-store writes, dry-run team resolution without mutations, required-field validation, and actionable rejection of unsupported resources.
